'''Revelation Quiet Mining Colony...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 QMC Revelation LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

TOO quiet...watch out! KTEOF!

This deck has seen some revisions.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Turn one: Activate 6, get a CC site. Wokling gets CC Celebration. Draw if you want, I don?t recommend it. Turn two: Activate 8. You now have 11 force. Get another CC site. If you have a couple scrubs in hand and a pilot, flip with them. Get the East Platform. Otherwise, flip next turn. You have plenty of ground evasion; but no space. So I recommend landing your ship at the East Platform and having the pilot get out. Third turn: Activate 11. Pick a card from force pile. Get a pilot and ship to Bespin. Deploy CC Celebration.  Fill up your third interior site. Fly the pilot you landed last turn back up. Fourth turn: Activate, pick a card, retrieve, and either beatdown or fill the East Platform with somebody; reinforce Bespin.. Fifth turn: Activate, pick a card, retrieve, beatdown. Just keep repeating the process. I?m thinking of adding space evasion- is that a good idea? Matchups:

Dark Deal: Get eaten.

BHBM: Don?t let him win battles, retrieve Your Destiny loss.

Hunt Down: Same as BHBM, pretty much.

I?ve taken to writing less matchups, since it?s pretty much the same idea for all of them

.
